title: Normalize ASFT updates with accumulated and global token counts
body:
# What does this PR do?

ASFT currently discards the accumulated `num_items_in_batch` supplied by Transformers. Because a custom loss function is installed, the training loop does not divide the result again by gradient accumulation steps. Each microbatch instead contributes its own local token mean, which changes both the scale and weighting of the update. The custom ASFT branch also bypasses the compensation for globally averaged token counts in distributed training.

Pass the supplied denominator to both the existing DFT term and the reference-policy KL term. When Transformers uses a global token count, apply the same process-count compensation used by its regular loss path. Without an explicit denominator, retain the existing local-token mean. The new optional argument is appended after the existing positional arguments.

## Validation

Exact tested source: `1ed526d55e90de9dcca5916f6eba25a2de4e9272`; upstream main: `6d1059c727450a4f58e56ad204d01a71abad7781`.

[Successful native CPU and two-rank Gloo run](https://github.com/Afloat16/LlamaFactory/actions/runs/43401400532), Python 3.12.16, PyTorch 2.9.1+cpu, Transformers 4.57.1, Accelerate 1.11.0:

- The identical 33 new tests on unchanged upstream: **20 failed, 13 passed**.
- Fixed source: **33 passed**, including all four actual two-process Gloo cases.
- Real TinyGPT2 training compares two SGD and AdamW updates with an independently aggregated full-token objective: losses, every parameter gradient, final parameters and optimizer states.
- Accumulated microbatches contain unequal numbers of valid tokens. Cases cover supplied integer/tensor counts, no-count compatibility, different ASFT weights, ordinary full batches and accumulation.
- Distributed cases compare the global six-example objective with each rank's actual model and optimizer trajectory, for both optimizers and both batch/accumulation configurations.
- The reference model remains frozen. Normal repository conftest is enabled; no checkpoint downloads or mocked Trainer/distributed operations are used.
- Ruff 0.15.9 lint/format and `git diff --check` passed.

```bash
python -m pytest -q tests/train/test_asft_token_normalization.py
ruff check src/llamafactory/train/sft/trainer.py src/llamafactory/train/trainer_utils.py tests/train/test_asft_token_normalization.py
ruff format --check src/llamafactory/train/sft/trainer.py src/llamafactory/train/trainer_utils.py tests/train/test_asft_token_normalization.py
```

GPU, DeepSpeed, FSDP, and the complete repository test suite were not run. The existing all-ignored ASFT and `return_outputs` behaviors are outside this change.

## Prior work checked

I checked the affected file histories, all-state ASFT/token-normalization/gradient-accumulation proposals, and all existing user-fork branches. #10174 introduces ASFT; #10454 addresses the regular SFT normalization path; #10845 concerns the output-return contract and #10741 concerns all-ignored targets. Their actual patches do not apply the accumulated/global token denominator to ASFT.

## Before submitting

- [x] Read the contributor guideline.
- [x] Added the necessary regression tests.

validation.style: Ruff 0.15.9 lint and format; git diff --check
limits: Actual CPU and two-rank Gloo only
All-ignored ASFT and return_outputs are separate unchanged behaviors
validation.fixture_revision: Independent KL oracle uses the native softmax reference probabilities directly; final identical test source rerun on both base and fixed source. AdamW eps=1e-6 avoids amplifying mathematically zero attention-bias rounding.

peer_review: Independent read-only review passed for production and all 33 tests.
